img.text:
Eleven kilometres
down... and we still got
there first?

I'm going to need a
bigger submarine.

How does a hole
this big exist?

So the ocean floor is...
sinking. On purpose.

Can somebody switch on a
light?

Don't go towards the
light! Never go towards
the light!

Soft is the secret. No
bones to crack, no air
to squeeze.

So when does the ocean
run out?

Eleven kilometres down.
In a place almost no
human has seen.
Drinking the ocean… breathing it out
Drinking the ocean… breathing it out
Most of the deep sea: never seen
Most of the deep sea: never seen

So the bottom of the
world... still has
secrets.
